composition_variation: Create a gentle portrait of Bond sitting on broad stone steps scattered with orange autumn leaves. His shaggy white fur catches soft backlight, and his dark paws rest symmetrically near the center. Use tactile colored-pencil textures, muted pumpkin and sage colors, a blurred garden railing, and a pleasant open-mouth expression. Keep the composition simple and comforting, with no leash-holder or human figures. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
